title: The Farm
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight mourns the death of his Aunt Shirley following Schrute family customs, including a unique dirt-throwing ritual to indicate invitation or distance. Family tensions arise as Aunt Shirley's farm is offered to Dwight and relatives, sparking debates about farm life. Meanwhile, Todd Packer attempts to make amends with the office by offering cupcakes, leading to mixed reactions and humorous incidents. Dwight also teaches Cameron farm skills, and the office shares strange experiences after consuming the laced cupcakes.
